boundaries: Snapshots are captured after each pytest call; assertionsCompleted only means the original call passed.
Table hashes cover every row, sorted by canonical JSON, including columns; they are execution fingerprints, not expected-value assertions.
Exact expected assertions remain in the linked test sources; observed state/count/hash does not replace them.
SQLite reads use mode=ro, query_only and an authorizer allowing only SELECT/READ/FUNCTION/TRANSACTION; no database is written or copied.
Only full unique 96 atomic + 48 round cases with setup/call/teardown passed and captured evidence permit passed status.
No test assertion, budget, retry, fixture or implementation is modified by this plugin.

fullRawArtifact.note: CI executes its own run; UUIDs/timestamps/hashes differ. Assertions and source identity must pass independently.

boundary: Captured state/table hashes supplement exact expected assertions in the linked tests; no count/hash alone establishes semantic correctness.
compactObservationBoundary: Per-cell table content is represented by one aggregate SHA of the complete per-table row-count/content-hash map. Full readonly observations remain in the linked raw JSONL artifact; exact expected assertions are in test source.
